title: Twelve Monkeys Kanzi Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Kanzi by Twelve Monkeys delivers a mouthwatering mix of luscious Strawberries, juicy Watermelon, and tangy Kiwi for a perfectly balanced fruit medley. The sweet and refreshing blend provides a vibrant inhale, while the tart Kiwi adds a subtle sharpness, making for a smooth and satisfying exhale. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Kanzi is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring rich vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. Twelve Monkeys is a globally recognised Canadian e-liquid brand, celebrated for its masterful blending of bold fruit flavours. Their expertly crafted e-liquids offer a premium vaping experience with every puff.
